name: SeeGlass Mirror
description: SeeGlass Standing Mirror is a stylish decorative design, made to bring a modern, cozy touch to bedrooms, dressing areas, and studio spaces. This standing mirror features a tall rounded mirror frame, warm wooden base, side support, and a small attached drawer for added detail and realism.
